newsitem.title: USA: Commonwealth Snack files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Commonwealth Snack files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

text.p: Commonwealth Snack Co Tuesday filed for Chapter 11 protection in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware.
In court papers the company listed assets of $1.6 million and liabilities of $3.0 million, with almost all of its unsecured debt related to trade and legal services.

Two Commonwealth subsidiaries, State Line Snacks Corp and Boyd Acquisition Co, also filed for protection under the U.S. Bankruptcy Code. A third unit, Boston Popcorn Co, is not included in the filing.
Commonwealth, a producer and distributor of snack food products, has operations in Wilbraham and Lynn, Mass.
In the bankruptcy court documents, Commonwealth is not listed as a publicly held company.
No one at the Lynn office, where calls were referred, was available for comment.
